text: Draft for synergy and team needs first. Fearless Draft creates one-off pairings that are not automatically better for your team.
Jhin, Miss Fortune and Ziggs need somebody else to start the fight.
Yunara, Zeri and Jinx need real peel/frontline. Do not spend all five picks on damage.
Jayce/Rumble/Ambessa top should not be your only pressure AND your only engage plan.
When a pro comp looks hard to execute, copy the jobs, not the exact champions.
Do not force Azir+Skarner because it worked earlier in the year. The playoff evidence moved away from it.
